description: Sends a paid design-help request to Formada3D with fixed prices: quick_fix (change an existing file, A$29, 1-2 business days), replacement (simple part rebuilt from photos and measurements, A$69, 3-5 days), new_design (from A$129, bigger jobs quoted first, 5-7 days); extra revision A$19. Returns a checkout_url (business.formada3d.com/design-help/) where the person pays and then uploads their files. Organic or sculpted shapes (figures, freeform or sculpted products, scan clean-up) take longer and cost more, so they are a custom quote depending on the designer. Printing is separate. The person pays on formada3d.com; nothing is paid by the AI. Requires user_confirmed=true, meaning the person asked for it and agreed to share their name and email. Rate-limited; links only, no files stored.

description.description: What it is, what it is for and what needs to change or be made (20-3000 chars).

links.description: Up to 5 links to photos (ruler in shot), sketches or the existing file. We do not download or store them here.

measurements.description: Key measurements in mm (overall size, hole sizes and spacing, wall thickness).

tier.description: quick_fix = change an existing file (A$29); replacement = rebuild a simple part from photos + measurements (A$69); new_design = new simple part (from A$129; bigger jobs quoted first).

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the person asked for this request and agreed to share these details.

name: design_request
title: Request paid design help
